Promo Info: Asia Special Prize for Jun.2023 Tamer Workshop
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] You may trash up to 3 blue cards from your hand. For each card trashed by this effect, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Digimon/Tamers and trash it. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon/Tamers without cards under it can't suspend until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, end that attack by returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their text from your trash to the bottom of your deck.
